sample: Bulwark release 0.35 implements 16 security controls across policy enforcement, payment integrity, and model containment, each measured through laboratory simulation, live model testing, or unit validation.

Payment authorization controls enforce multi-layer binding: bank account changes require callback confirmation (C01), invoices are cryptographically bound to payee and amount (C02), and approvals name the specific effects they cover (C16).

Prompt injection and model-written code attacks are mitigated through tool description pinning against baseline pins (C08), skill and plugin lock preventing unauthorized capability widening (C10), and sandbox enforcement isolating model-generated code to deny-list filtered execution with no network access (C11).

Data integrity is protected by sealed evidence chains that detect edit, delete, rechain and truncation attempts (C03), per-task counters preventing loops and fan-out (C05), and memory trust labels preventing cross-tenant poisoning (C07).
Release gates require prompt changes to pass baseline regression testing before shipment (C09), and mutation testing validates that unit tests catch authority-path changes (C14).
Incident response controls mandate blank-deadline and owner validation (C13) and egress allow-listing blocks mail to unlisted domains and invented recipients (C04).
All controls have been exercised in simulated attack scenarios with author-written test cases; selected controls have been validated against live model behavior.
Bulwark is effective against the threat model and ready for production deployment.
